target.statement: LLM2 improves Llama3-1B accuracy on GSM8K from 50.3 to 57.8 (+7.5)

compute.basis: Training a 1B verifier on synthetic data generated by 20 continuations per token over GSM8K requires GPU compute; paper used 8 A100s for 3 epochs, and inference with verifier adds overhead.

blockers: Requires generating synthetic process-supervision data with 20 continuations per token, which is computationally intensive
Verifier training needs GPU (paper used 8 A100 80GB GPUs)
Inference with LLM2 requires running both LLM and verifier, needing GPU for reasonable speed
title: LLM2: Let Large Language Models Harness System 2 Reasoning
